semantics.geometry_derivation: Exact OSM way1230327255 ordered node ring; display-only anchor is the mean of four unique corners of this parallelogram.
semantics.precision_scope: Source node coordinates retain seven decimal places. The mapped existing EDGE2 building locates one physical campus with phase3 electrical/mechanical construction; it is not an official cadastral or campus boundary, a surveyed footprint or the current work extent. Separate EDGE1, CGK, DGE1 and DGE2 are not merged. The brochure point remains rejected and source-map precision is not measured accuracy.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: OSM does not supply a survey method or quantitative positional accuracy for this feature. Numeric precision and agreement with earlier snapshots do not establish accuracy.

distinctness_review.method: Full 187 Point/Polygon/MultiPolygon geometries, including holes, compared with the complete source polygon using Shapely; all properties screened for EDGE2, EDGE 2, EG2, JKT2, Ekagrata and Kuningan Mulia.

remaining_review_gate: Independent source, identity, lifecycle/successor and full-geometry review, then separately pinned acceptance and full release validation. This proposal alone increments no count.
